Marta (Head of Private): Quick heads-up: previewing the Secure Image Transit Proxy (SITP) for Private/VPC customers. SITP enables signed, resumable image transfers via an outbound-only proxy that customers can restrict to a handful of IPs. Preview is pilot-only (6 customers). Pilot docs: https://intranet.redwood/sitp-preview :sparkles:
Eli (Infra): Tech summary: SITP provides an outbound TLS proxy with mutual TLS and per-customer certs. Images are streamed in chunks, validated locally (signature + checksum), and stored in a customer-controlled staging area. We recommend a default 90-minute weekly maintenance window for image staging and verification.
Samir (Security): Telemetry & compliance: pilot telemetry limited to chunk-level hashes, transfer success/failure, and timing metrics. No model or customer payloads leave the cluster. All images must be signed via our HSM-backed pipeline; we will publish SBOM and attestation artifacts for each image. Compliance notes: https://intranet.redwood/security/sitp :lock:
Priya (CS): Customer comms draft: "SITP lets you receive signed repair and feature images via a controlled outbound proxy with per-account certs. Opt-in required. Declining means manual image import and longer RTOs." I'll tailor per account.
Eli (Infra): Ops checklist (short): 1) confirm customer's allowed IP list 2) provision mTLS certs 3) verify staging ACLs 4) run chunked transfer + local verify 5) apply and run post-checks. Automatic rollback triggers if post-check error rate >6% within 10m.
Marta (Head of Private): Policy note: if SITP moves to GA we plan to require customers on managed Private support to permit outbound-only, signed image pulls during maintenance windows as a condition for proactive hotfix delivery. We'll give 45 days notice before enforcement. If anyone objects to the 45-day notice or the 90-minute maintenance window, please reply here by EOD Friday.
ops-bot: SITP-preview v0.1 scheduled -> infra-staging at 2105000600
Samir (Security): Action: add SITP to SOC tracker and prepare attestation bundle template. Customers requiring no outbound pulls must use an offline-image workflow and accept extended SLAs.
Marta (Head of Private): Pilot timeline: week 0 invite 6 customers -> weeks 1-2 run transfers + verification -> week 3 dry-run applies -> week 4 feedback + GA checklist. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
